name: zsnd_play_handle_set_freq_scaled
description: zSndPlayHandle::SetFreqScaled clamps a normalized pitch/frequency scale and applies the interpolated playback rate to the active backend handle.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a zSound backend/provider source-cluster pass; DirectSound and A3D provider vtable dispatches are modeled functionally.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a10e0 validates backend-handle and sample create-guard rejection, scale clamping to [0, 1], interpolation between playbackParam3 and playbackParam2, DirectSound SetFrequency dispatch at vtable slot 0x44 with error reporting at zsnd_parm.cpp line 218, and A3D SetPitchScaled dispatch at vtable slot 0xa8 using playbackRate / sampleRate.
The native smoke verifies DirectSound clamp-high and clamp-low frequencies, create-guard rejection, and the A3D normalized pitch path.
